test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: GMIE is related to HNJF in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, KQMI is related to LRNJ. To which of the following is NTPL related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

GMIE is related to HNJF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d68c2b8c0818c44a07c4c909c3c067d1ba131b89fd9e3634d850a0a43dc35ed8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05deb2b7dfe1112dfe45c0094ea9666098148840feb32051b6a93b8c31f554bc.png] 

KQMI is related to LRNJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d94ecc4fe93b4d8c7445d57c9c064f1e71000d44fc81ceacda7e292e9600a2d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/385b0c7c37a738088b0c445479f6b2f6927c8a46e02569bac18a214639d7469c.png] 

Similarly,

NTPL is related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f09426d15b6c0fa2bf698c97d8346ba44c4572126bf32b93550e1a0e314cb478.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e8151cbbfa745329a41aa5634bd91d9a7d2f3771106431ebe7ed02ba3b2e0b9.png] 

Thus, NTPL is related to OUQM.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
